entries.title: Remember Me

primary.why: Remember Me released for PlayStation 3, Windows, and Xbox 360 in June 2013. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version natively at the highest stable settings; use PS3 or Xbox 360 only for original-console comparison.

all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity and most flexible route.
